description:
Official Youtube Page of NBA Athlete Fred Vanvleet

Welcome to my official YouTube channel. The NBA player, father, entrepreneur, and someone who believes in betting on yourself. I’m giving you an inside look at my world both on and off the court. From behind-the-scenes moments, daily routines, and game day experiences, to travel, family, and the work we’re doing with the VanVleet Family Foundation — this is where you’ll get the full picture of the journey.

Tap in to see the grind, the wins, the lessons, and everything in between.
Subscribe for more exclusive access and follow along as we kee
